newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Sinar Mas unit issues 500 bln rph bonds.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Sinar Mas unit issues 500 bln rph bonds.

text.p: Indonesian finance company PT Sinar Mas Multifinance said on Thursday it will issue 500 billion rupiah straight bonds to boost its working capital.
PT Sinar Mas Multifinance is a unit of holding company Sinar Mas Multiartha. Both are part of the Sinar Mas group.
Sinar Mas Multifinance said the five-year straight bonds, rated BBB by the Indonesian rating agency Pefindo, will carry a fixed coupon of 15.65 percent a year, payable every quarter.
It said the issue, guaranteed by Sinar Mas Multiartha, was lead managed by PT Trimegah Securindolestari.
The bonds, to be offered from April 2 to 4, will be listed on the Surabaya Stock Exchange on April 21.
